about: E48, pass re-read (reports/plans/2026-10-29_plan_e48-pass-reread.md; decisions.md 'Card triage' items (2) and (7), user 2026-10-29). The saved teacher-trained copies of E42 and E34 (and E34's six arm-A copies, regenerated) read under the new pass reading: behaviour kept by the parts Gamma switches on, leftover weights at the original's, on the task's own text, as a share of the fine-tune's change and as a ratio to W0 on the same rows (commute.pass_reading; the share is commute.maps_score.kept, the Qwen line's r2). 67M decomposition, Gamma and Delta frozen, L40 debug QoS. Filed 2026-10-29 before any run; never edited after a run.

sources.f_line: the project's fixed line, 1.5 (faith_score.LINE; decisions.md 'Card triage' item (3), option (a): the fixed line on the ratio to W0), applied to W0 itself: W0's masked model on the cipher's trigger is 'already poor' when it reads at or over 1.5 times its own value on ordinary text
sources.ci_known, ci_tol: faith_score.W0_CI and W0_CI_TOL: W0's harness ci_masked_kl on the 256 Pile val rows, 0.348, 2% relative
sources.path_max: amend6's w0_pile_max (two forward paths of W0 agree), 1e-4 nats; here in fp32, where rounding is about 1e-7
sources.kept_min, floor_min: reports/plans/2026-10-28_plan_qwen-q0q1.md section 3: r2 >= 0.8 where scored; scored where K(D) - K0 >= 0.05 nats (floor_mult x spread is 0 here: the CI-masked reading of a state is deterministic; the batch-order spread is measured in-job and reported, P6)
sources.teacher_p_tol, teacher_size_tol: amend6's ref_tol: a regenerated teacher is the filed one when P(target) is within 0.01 and size within 0.003
sources.gap_tol: E41's not_worse gap-share tolerances (about twice E34 Amendment 4's batch-order spread of the teacher gap share, 0.002 arm A, 0.010 arm B), times the teacher's gap at W0
sources.near_zero: the Qwen Q0 plan's control (i) threshold, g > 0.01 counts as switched on
sources.handful, hundreds: E42 analysis 'What next' item 1: 'a handful ... points to a small Gamma change as the repair; hundreds sharing it does not'; 10 and 100 set the words

measurements.masked model: a state's forward with every subcomponent at Gamma's g (Gamma on the state's own activations) and Delta at W0's Delta_0 under mask 1; Delta off reported beside (the Qwen Q0 plan's and E42's convention)
measurements.K(X): mean over the task's held-out windows of KL(fine-tuned model || masked model of X) at the trigger, nats
measurements.K(D): K of the unchanged decomposition (W0) against the fine-tune
measurements.K0: W0's own: KL(W0 || masked W0) at the trigger, same windows
measurements.share kept: [K(D) - K(X)] / [K(D) - K0], maps_score.kept; 1 = as faithful to the fine-tune as W0's decomposition is to W0
measurements.ratio: K(X) / K0, reported; the 1.5 line is printed beside it, not scored
measurements.F: S1: K0 at the trigger of a cipher's held-out windows / W0's K per position on the harness's 256 Pile val rows (both Delta at Delta_0)
measurements.carriers: per alive subcomponent of an E42 arm-A copy, the drop in the copy's mean trigger log-odds when its change alone is reverted (attribution.revert_one, fp32); n50, n90; the n50 set's share with mean g at the trigger < 0.01; the n50 set reverted together

expected.W0: Pile K_off 0.348 (A1); path check Delta on below 1e-6, Delta off about 0.012 (the harness's unmasked_kl); K0 at the cipher trigger: Delta off about 0.69 (E42 Amendment 1, rand32 training windows), Delta on 0.4-0.7, no reference; Pile K Delta on 0.25-0.35, no reference; F 1.4-2.4, F_off about 2.0 (0.69 / 0.348); K0 at the E34 tasks' triggers no reference (E42 Amendment 1's cipher windows away from the trigger read 0.44)
expected.K(D): about the teacher's gap at W0 at the trigger: rand32 about 13, rand1 about 10.4, ident32 about 10.1 nats (E42 gap_w0 13.19 / 10.49 / 10.19, which add about 0.06 of KL elsewhere)
expected.do-nothing: rand32 share 0.6-0.8 (masked P 0.016 in E42's Delta-off cells: about 4 nats left of 13), rand1 0.2-0.5 (masked P 0.001), ident32 0.9-1.1 (masked P 0.958: Gamma switching on existing subcomponents carries the copying); ratios rand32 5-9, rand1 9-14, ident32 below 1 (the fine-tune's peaked distribution gives a small KL)
expected.E42 task-text copies: rand32 share 0.5-0.75 (masked P 0.007), rand1 0.2-0.5 (0.001), ident32 0.9-1.1 (0.929); the Delta-off shares near the Delta-on ones (Delta_0 is a small residual)
expected.E42 Pile-text copies: rand32 and ident32 shares near 0 or negative (the copies did not learn: P 0.02 and 0.001), rand1 0.1-0.5 (P 0.91, unmasked; masked unknown)
expected.teacher checks: the three E42 teachers reproduce exactly (same card and recipe; E42's G1 matched E10 to four decimals); the H100 teachers (r1 SGD, r2 SGD, three LoRAs) may miss: E26 read r1's SGD fine-tune at P 0.990 on an H100 and 0.922 on an L40

predictions.kind: control and stop rule, filed with a lean
predictions.rule: A1: |W0's Delta-off Pile K / 0.348 - 1| <= 0.02, and A2: fp32 path check Delta on <= 1e-4; either fails: stop, apparatus (nothing read). Then F per stop task (rand32, rand1): 'fallback' if F is NaN or round(F, 9) >= 1.5 on either; else 'read'. Absolute line on a ratio. Fallback: the job stops after S1, reading A decides (option (c)) with the cue reading printed beside it
predictions.lean: fallback, medium-low: Delta off the existing numbers read 0.69 / 0.348 = 2.0; whether Delta_0 lowers the trigger KL more than the Pile KL is unknown
predictions.blind_to: position type: the trigger is one position after a marker never seen in Pile text, compared with the mean over every Pile position; W0's K at the E34 tasks' triggers is printed beside as the same-position-type reference
predictions.edge_cases: Pile K = 0 or non-finite: F NaN -> fallback, and A1 fails first; F exactly 1.5: fallback (inclusive)

predictions.kind: classification per task, filed with a lean
predictions.rule: per E42 arm-A copy at step 1000: share kept; 'unscored' if K(D) - K0 < 0.05; 'missing' if NaN; 'kept' if round(share, 9) >= 0.8; else 'not kept'. A copy whose check misses (teacher or copy not reproduced) is 'unmatched', not scored. New pass = reading A's filed verdict 'pass' and 'kept'. Absolute
predictions.lean: rand32 high (masked P 0.007 against 0.96), rand1 high (0.001 against 1.00), ident32 medium-high (0.929 against 0.98)
predictions.blind_to: the share is in nats: a masked model at 2% where the fine-tune puts 99% still keeps over half of a 13-nat change, so the reading is lenient on probability; one batch order; one teacher seed; the trigger position only (kl_other reported)

predictions.kind: controls of the reading on E42's tasks
predictions.rule: do-nothing (the fine-tune in Delta; the masked forward uses Delta_0): class as P1. Negative control: rand32 and rand1 'not kept'. Positive control: ident32 'kept'. The reading has teeth if rand1 reads 'not kept' and ident32 'kept'; rand32's do-nothing is the near-line case
predictions.lean: rand1 high, ident32 medium-high, rand32 medium (expected 0.6-0.8, close to the line)
predictions.blind_to: do-nothing passes this reading wherever Gamma alone carries the behaviour (ident32, and probably E34's rung 0 and 1 tasks): it cannot fail a map that leaves the components unchanged when switching existing ones on is enough; reading A's adversarial check is what fails do-nothing there

predictions.rule: the r2 t275 task-text copy (amend6 arm A, seed 0, step 1000): class as P1; also reported against its own teacher's P (0.86)
predictions.lean: low: label-trained component training on r2 t275 kept 0.66 of the log-odds gain under the CI mask at step 10 (task ladder, E5); the copy's masked share is unread; the teacher was trained on an H100 with SGD and may not reproduce on an L40 (then 'unmatched')

outcomes.not kept: decision (7): the rare target is 'not placed' by the new pass, no rerun
outcomes.kept: 'not placed, narrow miss' stands (reading A was below P 0.9)
outcomes.unmatched: the re-read needs an H100 (about $1) to regenerate the same teacher; card

predictions.rule: E34 Amendment 5's r1 t534 task-text copies (SGD teacher, batch-order seeds 0 and 1): class as P1
predictions.lean: low: on r1 t534, label-trained component training kept 0.79 of the log-odds gain under the CI mask (E5); the teacher is an H100 SGD fine-tune
predictions.reported_beside: the Pile-text copies of the same teacher (B0, B1), the r2 Pile-text copy, the six LoRA Pile-text copies: class and share, no lean

predictions.kind: classification per teacher, filed with a lean (regen job, only after S1 read 'read')
predictions.rule: E34's six arm-A copies regenerated on the L40 by E34's recipe (Adam 1e-5, 1,000 steps, batch 32, seed 0) against the regenerated teacher: class as P1; their E34 (H100) P and gap printed beside; reading A's verdict is the H100 copy's
predictions.lean: low on all: E5's log-odds shares kept under the CI mask were 0.56 (emoticon), 0.82 (r0 t352), 0.79 (r1 t534) for label training at step 10; teacher training to step 1,000 is unread

predictions.rule: the largest |share(seed 0) - share(seed 1)| over Amendment 5's two pairs (A0/A1, B0/B1; same teacher, step and arm). A class within that distance of 0.8 is flagged 'near line'
predictions.expected: under 0.05 (E34 Amendment 4: P(target) moved 0.005 between batch orders on task text)

predictions.rule: per E42 arm-A copy: n50 = the fewest largest revert-one drops reaching 50% of the summed positive drops; 'a handful' if n50 <= 10, 'hundreds' if >= 100, else 'tens'; 'none positive' if no drop is positive. Reported beside: n90, the n50 set's share with g at the trigger < 0.01 under the copy, the n50 set reverted together as a fraction of the gain
predictions.lean: low: teacher training moves every alive subcomponent (Adam on all offsets), but a one-pair cipher should need few directions; no reference
predictions.blind_to: revert-one drops need not add (the joint revert reads that); fp32 single-subcomponent reverts of a 20-log-odds gain may each be small

not_run: E41's copies (T10, T100 one-shot and the chains): none was saved; 12 copies at 115-158 s each on an L40 plus teachers is about 30 min, a job at the debug cap's edge; E41's one-shot T1000 arm-A copies on emoticon and r1 are E34's Adam copies, regenerated in the regen job
E34's six main arm-B (Pile-text) copies: not saved; another 16 min on an L40, a third job; arm B is read on the 11 saved Pile-text copies
E42 Amendment 2's M0 states: their teacher is W0 (nothing to copy), so K(D) - K0 is 0 by construction and the share is undefined
E43's plus-remainder states and E42 Amendment 1's masked copies: not saved
any adversarial or stochastic Pile reading: reading A's verdicts are taken from the results files
a second card: every teacher is regenerated on the L40; an H100 rerun of the H100-trained copies only if their check misses
